verdict.rationale: Galileo has its own Python/TypeScript SDK for logging traces and evaluating application code programmatically, so the product can be driven from code without the console UI. However, nothing in the evidence documents CI pipeline integration, a CLI, or eval gating in automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs (e.g., GitHub Actions or pass/fail gates on experiment results), a headless CLI, documented programmatic experiment runs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
